request.deadline: 2026 funding period; exact deadline not stated in document
deliverables: 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support
Maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
Support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
Vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 for Cardano hardware-wallet support, including Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates, supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli maintenance, developer support, integration-path support, and vendor-required audits.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ADA, consisting of 1,272,777 ADA for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance & Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ADA for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The requested funding covers 12 months of production maintenance for Cardano hardware-wallet support rather than building a new wallet product.

The proposer says continuous maintenance is necessary because Cardano protocol evolution, Ledger and Trezor release cycles, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk at the hardware-wallet access layer.
The proposer claims funding continuity in 2026 is less costly and less disruptive than waiting for breakage to accumulate and reacting after users or integrators lose access.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer claims the withdrawal does not, at the time of submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will administer the funds through a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework using one Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract.
The proposal states an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl will provide checks and balances on Intersect administrative actions.
The proposer says a community dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi and on-chain records will allow auditing of the withdrawn ADA and related metrics.

The proposal states prior treasury or Catalyst funding disclosures for related hardware-wallet, Ledger, Plutus, security, and developer ecosystem work through listed governance-action and Project Catalyst links.

summary: The document describes a 1,310,960 ADA treasury withdrawal submitted by Intersect on behalf of a vendor for 2026 hardware-wallet maintenance, with a high-level budget, smart-contract custody and oversight details, prior funding links, and references to Hydra voting and audits, but it does not provide a detailed milestone schedule, vendor identity, granular cost justification, risk analysis, alternatives analysis, or failure-mode analysis.
